_note: Curated package information for the Packages tab (docs/APPSHUB_PLAN.md, App11). Written offline from what the repo documents and what is common knowledge about Enigma2/DreamOS; descriptions that were not certain are left out on purpose (the package's own apt Description is shown instead). The owner and the box feed fill the rest: run 'go run ./cmd/pkginfo-missing <Packages file>' to list the feed packages without an entry. Keys are package names; 'category' is optional (otherwise derived from the name, see category.go); 'neededBy' lists hub ids (the UI shows their plain page names). Names marked in 'unverified' follow the Enigma2 naming convention but have not been seen on the DreamOS feed yet; an entry whose name the feed does not use is simply never shown.

description.de: Die Hauptanwendung der Box: Fernsehen, Aufnahmen, Menüs und Plugins laufen darin.
description.en: The box's main application: TV, recordings, menus and plugins all run inside it.
description.it: L'applicazione principale del box: TV, registrazioni, menu e plugin funzionano al suo interno.

description.de: Werkzeug zum Umwandeln, Schneiden und Untersuchen von Video und Audio. Wird zum Kürzen von Aufnahmen und zur Werbeerkennung gebraucht.
description.en: Tool for converting, cutting and inspecting video and audio. Used for trimming recordings and detecting ads.
description.it: Strumento per convertire, tagliare e analizzare video e audio. Serve per accorciare le registrazioni e rilevare la pubblicità.

description.de: Kernel-Modul für das Overlay-Dateisystem. Docker braucht es, um Container-Schichten zu verwalten.
description.en: Kernel module for the overlay file system. Docker needs it to manage container layers.
description.it: Modulo del kernel per il file system overlay. Docker lo usa per gestire i livelli dei container.

description.de: DreamHub selbst: diese Weboberfläche und alles dahinter.
description.en: DreamHub itself: this web interface and everything behind it.
description.it: DreamHub stesso: questa interfaccia web e tutto ciò che c'è dietro.

description.de: Fügt dem Bildschirm der Box eine DreamHub-Taste hinzu.
description.en: Adds a DreamHub button to the box's on-screen skin.
description.it: Aggiunge un pulsante DreamHub allo skin a schermo del box.

description.de: MediaPortal: Mediatheken, Streaming-Seiten und weitere Videoquellen direkt auf dem Fernseher.
description.en: MediaPortal: media libraries, streaming sites and other video sources directly on the TV.
description.it: MediaPortal: mediateche, siti di streaming e altre fonti video direttamente sulla TV.

description.de: Zusatzmodul für MediaPortal: Anbindungen an externe Videoportale.
description.en: Add-on module for MediaPortal: connections to external video hosts.
description.it: Modulo aggiuntivo per MediaPortal: collegamenti a servizi video esterni.

description.de: AutoTimer: legt Aufnahmen automatisch an, wenn eine Sendung zu einer gespeicherten Suche passt.
description.en: AutoTimer: creates recordings automatically when a programme matches a saved search.
description.it: AutoTimer: crea automaticamente le registrazioni quando un programma corrisponde a una ricerca salvata.

description.de: Bouquet-Editor: Senderlisten anlegen, sortieren und umbenennen, auch von außen über die Weboberfläche.
description.en: Bouquet editor: create, sort and rename channel lists, also from outside through the web interface.
description.it: Editor dei bouquet: crea, ordina e rinomina le liste dei canali, anche dall'esterno tramite l'interfaccia web.

description.de: SerienRecorder: nimmt Serien automatisch auf, Folge für Folge, und merkt sich, was schon da ist.
description.en: SerienRecorder: records series automatically, episode by episode, and remembers what you already have.
description.it: SerienRecorder: registra automaticamente le serie, episodio per episodio, e ricorda cosa hai già.

description.de: EPGRefresh: aktualisiert das Programmheft regelmäßig im Hintergrund, indem es Sender nacheinander durchschaltet.
description.en: EPGRefresh: keeps the programme guide up to date in the background by tuning through channels one after another.
description.it: EPGRefresh: mantiene aggiornata la guida programmi in background sintonizzando i canali uno dopo l'altro.

description.de: Stellt ein Terminal im Browser bereit. DreamHub zeigt es unter Gerät, Erweitert hinter dem eigenen Login.
description.en: Provides a terminal in the browser. DreamHub shows it under Device, Advanced, behind its own sign-in.
description.it: Fornisce un terminale nel browser. DreamHub lo mostra in Dispositivo, Avanzate, dietro al proprio accesso.

description.de: Schlanker SSH-Server für den Fernzugriff auf die Kommandozeile der Box.
description.en: Lightweight SSH server for remote access to the box's command line.
description.it: Server SSH leggero per l'accesso remoto alla riga di comando del box.

description.de: Zeigt laufende Prozesse samt Prozessor- und Speicherverbrauch auf der Kommandozeile.
description.en: Shows running processes with their CPU and memory use on the command line.
description.it: Mostra i processi in esecuzione con l'uso di processore e memoria sulla riga di comando.
